station: Lisbon Finals, citizen-science station under the LPPT (Lisbon Humberto Delgado) RWY 02 approach

location.coordinates_note: terrace position from Google Earth, corrected on 2026-10-10 (value published before: 38.754483, -9.149978, about 62 m further south)
location.rwy02_threshold_reference: AIP Portugal LPPT AD 2.12: RWY 02 THR 38 45 59.14 N, 009 08 38.05 W, elevation 100.6 m (threshold permanently displaced 90 m); distance 1372 m, bearing 22.6 deg from the station, in line with the 22.7 deg final approach track
location.elevation_m_amsl: approx. 80 (Google Earth terrain at the building, first-floor terrace + ~3 m; not surveyed)
location.setting: south-facing first-floor terrace of a residential building, Avenida do Brasil area, Lisbon
location.mounting: all sensors in a clear acrylic box with two rows of holes drilled directly in front of the microphone (foam windscreen fitted); the box sits inside a slatted wooden cabinet that lets sound and wind through while shading it from sun and heat. The effect of the enclosure on measured levels has not been quantified.

sound.sensor: Gain Express SLM-25 sound level meter, IEC 651 type 2 (manufacturer tolerance +/-1.5 dB at 94 dB / 1 kHz), analogue output read by an ADS1115 ADC
sound.conversion: dB = 30 + V / 0.033 (33 mV per dB, 30 dB floor), per manufacturer datasheet
sound.time_averaging: 125 ms, aligned on the standard FAST time constant
sound.frequency_weighting: A (meter display reads dBA; checked on site 2026-10-10)
sound.time_weighting: FAST (shown on the meter display; checked on site 2026-10-10)
sound.acoustic_calibration: measurement chain validated on site against two independent meters at the same time, agreement within 1 to 2 dB (after the switch to 125 ms averaging); a check with a certified 94 dB acoustic calibrator has not been done yet
sound.continuous_log: 1 sample per second, Unix time (UTC), since 2026-09-03 15:10 local time
sound.per_flight: peak level in the pass window and seconds above 70 dB

aircraft.altitude: barometric altitude as broadcast (alt_baro, standard 1013.25 hPa reference, feet), GNSS altitude as fallback; not corrected to local QNH
aircraft.heading: track/heading as broadcast, degrees
aircraft.position: since 2026-10-10 evening: aircraft GNSS position as broadcast in ADS-B (lat/lon, WGS84), kept only when received less than 2 s earlier and timestamped accordingly (UTC Unix time). Per flight: closest point of approach to the station (cpa_*) and position at the time of the SPL peak (peak_*, nearest position within 3 s). Horizontal distances are great-circle distances to the station. *_alt_amsl_m = GNSS altitude broadcast by the aircraft (alt_geom, height above the WGS84 ellipsoid) minus a geoid height of 55 m for Lisbon; slant distances use this altitude minus the station elevation (80 m). Checked on the first pass: 196 m AMSL at the station versus about 188 m on the published 3 deg ILS glide path. alt_baro is pressure altitude (1013.25 hPa reference), not corrected to QNH, kept for reference only. nac_p is the ADS-B Navigation Accuracy Category for position (8 = better than 92 m, 9 = better than 30 m, 10 = better than 10 m). Earlier flights have no position.
aircraft.tracks: tracks_*.zip: every position received while the aircraft was within 5 km of the station and between 200 and 5000 ft, about one point per second; one row per position, grouped by pass (hex + cpa_unix_time). In practice the receiving antenna (low on the terrace, buildings around) picks up landing aircraft from about 1.6 km before the station to about 0.7 km after it, i.e. roughly 20 to 30 s per pass, which covers the closest point of approach and the noise peak

weather.source: Open-Meteo model (wind, temperature, humidity, pressure) polled every 5 min at grid point 38.7749, -9.1397 (airport area, about 2.4 km north of the station); NOT a sensor on the terrace
weather.stored: value at the moment of each flight only; no continuous weather history

air_quality.note: ambient measurement; cannot be attributed to an individual flight, therefore not included in the flight files

time_reference.flight_files: date and time columns are local Lisbon time (Europe/Lisbon: WEST UTC+1 in summer, WET UTC+0 in winter); unix_time columns are UTC

known_limitations: June 2026: some peak values from the earlier ADC setup are not reliable (kept, see data_quality where flagged)
2026-09-03/04: continuous log incomplete and a duration bug; daily indicators start on 2026-09-05
2026-09-29: sensor box moved during maintenance; affected flights flagged sensor_box_moved
Single consumer-grade sensor on one terrace: local, independent evidence, not a reference network
